simple.summary: מָבֻשׁ (mâbush) means (plural) the (male) pudenda First listed occurrence: Deut 25 11.

definitions.full: H4016. mabush [ מבושׁ ] noun [masculine] plural suffix מְבֻשָׁיו , his privates , that excite shame, pudenda , Deut 25:11 . בַּז see below בזז .
